summary: The hawkish June Fed meeting — where the FOMC held rates at 3.50–3.75% but revised its median 2026 policy rate up to 3.8% and PCE inflation forecast to 3.6% — has been the dominant catalyst this week, rapidly repricing rate-hike risk across assets.
tweet: The market has shifted from "higher for longer" to pricing outright hike risk after the Fed's hawkish June meeting — gold is breaking, bonds are rallying, and rate sensitivity is the trade of the week.
